patient_context.dialectal_input: Look this is the third time your system bounced my paperwork back. The deadline is tomorrow and my specialist says if I miss this biologic dose my joints lock completely up. Stop giving me computer responses. I need a person right now.

patient_stated_timeline.event_description: First appeal rejected for improper formatting.
Secondary appeal letter submitted via portal.
Portal error flags conflicting dates of diagnosis.

denial_metadata.denial_clause_text: Section 12.A: Final grievance window expires 30 days post-denial. Hard stop.
